Title: Login
Story: As a user I want to log in with valid credentials so that I can access my account dashboard.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given login page; When valid credentials submitted; Then dashboard opens

Title: Invalid login
Story: As a user I want to see a clear error when my password is wrong so that I know login failed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Show exact wrong-password message; stay on login

Title: Cart
Story: As a shopper I want to add an item to my cart so that I can purchase it later.
AcceptanceCriteria: Add from PDP; cart count increments
